exactCurrentOperatorFacts.coinBonusTrigger: 6 or more Bonus Coins or qualifying combination with Prize/Collect/Mystery/Mystery Prize Coins
exactCurrentOperatorFacts.coinSuperbonusTrigger: qualifying six-symbol combination including Superbonus Coin
exactCurrentOperatorFacts.coinBonusSettlement: when feature ends, symbol values are summed into total win

conservativeFiveCoinState.requiredObservedState: exactly five or more visible regular Bonus Coins on the saved bet-level board, with their displayed X values captured before wager
conservativeFiveCoinState.nextEventModeled: at least one additional regular Bonus Coin appears and completes the six-symbol Coin Bonus condition
conservativeFiveCoinState.payoutFloorFormulaX: sum(visible regular Bonus Coin X values) + 1

whyThisMatters.reason: Changing stake selects a documented saved board state. The research signal is the stored symbols and displayed values, not a fixed number of spins at each stake.

priority.reason: Exact current Spanish operator rules provide per-bet saved sticky state, visible 1x-9x coin values and a six-symbol feature threshold, enabling a conservative one-spin probability threshold from five visible regular Bonus Coins.
